parameters.text:
=Anda adalah Senior Web Editorial Designer & Scrollytelling Architect.
Tugas Anda adalah memecah materi user menjadi kerangka struktur web (Scrollytelling) yang dinamis, berwibawa, dan elegan.

INFORMASI KONTEN:
- Brand / Entitas: {{ $json._sanitized.brandName || '-' }}
- Persona / Nada: {{ $json._sanitized.persona }}
- Target Audiens: {{ $json._sanitized.targetAudience }}
- Gaya Gulir: {{ $json._sanitized.scrollStyle }}
- Tema Visual: {{ $json._sanitized.deckTheme || 'Default / Auto' }}

OUTPUT JSON WAJIB MENGIKUTI SCHEMA INI DENGAN TEPAT:
{
  "metadata": {
    "topic": "Judul Utama Topik",
    "language": "{{ $json._sanitized.language }}"
  },
  "sections": [
    {
      "n": 1,
      "kind": "hero",
      "badge": "INTRO",
      "title": "Headline Halaman yang Kuat",
      "subtitle": "Penjelasan singkat pembuka",
      "narrative": "Teks pembuka yang menggugah...",
      "highlightWords": "Kata Penekanan",
      "imageRequired": true,
      "imageKeyword": "thoughtful designer laptop landscape",
      "keyPoints": [],
      "stats": []
    }
  ]
}

ATURAN STRUKTUR SECTION:
1. sections.kind WAJIB diisi SATU DARI:
   - "hero"           → Section cover pembuka (layar penuh, judul display besar, kicker badge).
   - "sticky-media"   → Teks narasi di kiri, visual media sticky di kanan.
   - "stat-reveal"    → Metrik/KPI penting dengan angka besar dan konteks narasi.
   - "parallax-split" → Dua panel kontras (masalah vs solusi, analogi, perbandingan).
   - "option-grid"    → 3-4 kartu bento solusi, pilar, atau fitur utama.
   - "timeline-track" → Kronologi alur langkah, fase, atau roadmap.
   - "closing"        → Section penutup dengan kesimpulan / takeaway utama materi.
2. section pertama WAJIB "hero".
3. section terakhir WAJIB "closing".
4. hasilkan tepat {{ $json._sanitized.sectionCount }} section.
5. `highlightWords`: pilih 1-3 kata kunci paling penting dalam title untuk penekanan aksen 10%.
6. `imageRequired`: boolean (true jika layout membutuhkan foto visual pendukung).
7. `imageKeyword`: kata kunci bahasa Inggris untuk pencarian Pexels (maks 3 kata).
8. Bahasa output: {{ $json._sanitized.language === 'en' ? 'English' : ($json._sanitized.language === 'ar' ? 'Arabic' : 'Indonesian') }}.

MATERI SUMBER:
{{ $json._sanitized.material }}

options.formDescription: Periksa dan edit teks pada setiap section sebelum menyetujui proses desain.

parameters.text:
=BAHASA OUTPUT (WAJIB): {{ $('Format Fields').item.json.outputLanguage === 'en' ? 'English' : ($('Format Fields').item.json.outputLanguage === 'ar' ? 'Arabic' : 'Indonesian') }}

Anda adalah **Content Classifier** untuk Sleyd Scroll — dek presentasi berbasis guliran (scrollytelling).

Tugas: baca MATERI di bawah, lalu balas **hanya JSON valid** berisi klasifikasi & satu field kunci `mood` yang akan dipakai untuk memilih tema visual.

MATERI:
{{ $json.material }}

BRAND     : {{ $json.brandName }}
PERSONA   : {{ $json.persona }}
AUDIENS   : {{ $json.targetAudience }}

Format output (WAJIB persis begini, JSON polos tanpa markdown / tanpa fence):
{
  "documentType": "<salah satu: business_report | startup_pitch | training_material | educational_content | company_profile | product_launch | proposal | research_report | roadmap | general_presentation>",
  "detectedLanguage": "<nama bahasa mayoritas materi, mis. Indonesian / English>",
  "complexity": "<low | medium | high>",
  "mood": "<WAJIB salah satu PERSIS dari daftar ini — inilah yang menentukan tema visual: technology | tech | saas | fintech | premium | luxury | brand | wellness | health | nature | education | creative | editorial | consultant | corporate | professional>",
  "containsStatistics": <boolean>,
  "containsTimeline":   <boolean>,
  "containsProcess":    <boolean>,
  "containsComparison": <boolean>,
  "containsKPI":        <boolean>,
  "visualIntent":  ["<maksimal 5 kata kunci visual yang MENGGAMBARKAN materi ini spesifik, BUKAN generic 'business presentation'>"],
  "imageKeywords": ["<maksimal 3 keyword Inggris untuk Pexels, TIAP keyword mencerminkan materi konkret ini, bukan template>"]
}

ATURAN PENTING:
- Field `mood` WAJIB tepat salah satu label di daftar — sistem me-mapping label ini ke tema warna (mis. 'fintech' → tema biru dalam, 'wellness' → lavender lembut).
- Pilih `mood` berdasarkan APA yang materi bahas, bukan brand-nya. Materi tentang aplikasi keuangan UMKM → `fintech`. Materi tentang klinik → `health`. Materi tentang agensi kreatif → `creative`.
- `imageKeywords` HARUS spesifik. DILARANG default seperti 'business presentation', 'workflow process', 'content review' — itu tanda Anda mengabaikan materi.

// ── 1. Robust JSON Extraction from Narrative Architect ───────────────
const fmtJson = $('Format Fields').first().json;
const prepJson = $('Prep Narrative Input').first().json || fmtJson;
const archRaw = $input.first().json.text || $input.first().json.output || "{}";

let cleanArchRaw = String(archRaw).replace(/```json/gi, '').replace(/```/g, '').trim();
const startBracket = cleanArchRaw.indexOf('{');
const endBracket   = cleanArchRaw.lastIndexOf('}');
if (startBracket !== -1 && endBracket !== -1) {
    cleanArchRaw = cleanArchRaw.substring(startBracket, endBracket + 1);
}

let archData = {};
try { archData = JSON.parse(cleanArchRaw); } catch(e) { archData = {}; }

const approvedOutline = fmtJson.approvedOutline;
let sections = [];

if (approvedOutline && Array.isArray(approvedOutline.sections) && approvedOutline.sections.length > 0) {
    sections = approvedOutline.sections;
} else {
    sections = archData.sections || [];
}

if (!sections.length) {
    throw new Error("SPLIT_SECTIONS: sections array kosong atau format JSON Narrative Architect tidak terbaca.");
}

// ── 2. Theme Resolution ──────────
const preferredTheme = fmtJson.deckTheme || (approvedOutline && approvedOutline.deckTheme) || "";
let themeKey = preferredTheme;

if (!CATALOG[themeKey]) {
    let ccOut = "{}";
    try {
        ccOut = prepJson.classifierRaw || $('Content Classifier').first().json.text || "{}";
    } catch(e) {}
    
    let cleanCc = String(ccOut).replace(/```json/gi, '').replace(/```/g, '').trim();
    const fb = cleanCc.indexOf('{');
    const lb = cleanCc.lastIndexOf('}');
    if (fb !== -1 && lb !== -1) cleanCc = cleanCc.substring(fb, lb + 1);
    
    let ccData = {};
    try { ccData = JSON.parse(cleanCc); } catch(e) { ccData = prepJson.classifier || {}; }
    const mood = (ccData.mood || "technology").toLowerCase();
    
    const MOOD_MAP = {
        technology: "champion-blue", tech: "champion-blue", saas: "atlantic-blue", startup: "exotic-orange",
        fintech: "midnight-blue", crypto: "midnight-blue", pitch: "champion-blue", premium: "dirty-white",
        luxury: "masterpiece-red", brand: "exotic-orange",
        wellness: "authentic-teal", health: "authentic-teal", nature: "yellow-green-shade",
        education: "sidecar-yellow", creative: "lavender-tonic", editorial: "dirty-white",
        consultant: "atlantic-blue", corporate: "atlantic-blue", professional: "atlantic-blue"
    };
    themeKey = MOOD_MAP[mood] || "champion-blue";
}

const t = CATALOG[themeKey] || CATALOG["champion-blue"];

// Typography Resolution
const userTypography = (fmtJson.typography && fmtJson.typography !== "Otomatis") ? fmtJson.typography : (approvedOutline && approvedOutline.typography && approvedOutline.typography !== "Otomatis" ? approvedOutline.typography : "");
const fontHeading    = userTypography || t.fontHeading || "Outfit";
const fontBody       = userTypography || t.fontBody || "Inter";

const scrollStyle  = fmtJson.scrollStyle  || (approvedOutline && approvedOutline.scrollStyle) || "free-flow";
const revealStyle  = fmtJson.revealStyle  || (approvedOutline && approvedOutline.revealStyle) || "slide-up";
const parallax     = fmtJson.parallax     || (approvedOutline && approvedOutline.parallax) || "subtle";
const sectionCount = sections.length;

const styleVars = [
    `--bg:${t.bg}`,
    `--bg-grad:${t.bgGrad || t.bg}`,
    `--surface:${t.surface}`,
    `--surface-hover:${t.surfaceHover || t.surface}`,
    `--text:${t.text}`,
    `--text-soft:${t.textSoft}`,
    `--accent:${t.accent}`,
    `--accent-bright:${t.accentBright || t.accent}`,
    `--accent-glow:${t.isDark ? (t.accentBright || t.accent) : t.accent}`,
    `--accent-rgb:${t.accentRgb || "37, 99, 235"}`,
    `--accent2-rgb:${t.accent2Rgb || t.accentRgb || "79, 70, 229"}`,
    `--accent-contrast:${t.accentContrast || "#FFFFFF"}`,
    `--border:${t.border}`,
    `--border-hover:${t.borderHover || t.border}`,
    `--accent-soft:${t.accentSoft || 'rgba(' + (t.accentRgb || '37,99,235') + ',0.15)'}`,
    `--font-display:clamp(2.5rem, 1.5rem + 5vw, 5rem)`,
    `--font-heading-size:clamp(1.85rem, 1.35rem + 2.5vw, 3rem)`,
    `--font-body-size:clamp(1rem, 0.95rem + 0.25vw, 1.125rem)`,
    `--font-caption:clamp(0.75rem, 0.7rem + 0.2vw, 0.875rem)`,
    `--card-shadow:${t.cardShadow}`,
    `--is-dark:${t.isDark ? '1' : '0'}`,
    `--ease:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)`,
    `--scrim-top:${t.isDark ? t.bg+'99' : t.bg+'CC'}`,
    `--scrim-mid:${t.isDark ? t.bg+'E6' : t.bg+'F2'}`,
    `--title-weight:${t.titleWeight || (t.isDark ? (fontHeading === 'Archivo' ? '400' : '700') : (fontHeading === 'Fraunces' ? '500' : '800'))}`,
    `--title-tracking:${t.titleTracking || (t.isDark ? (fontHeading === 'Archivo' ? '0.06em' : '-0.02em') : (fontHeading === 'Fraunces' ? '-0.01em' : '-0.04em'))}`,
    `--title-transform:${t.titleTransform || ((fontHeading === 'Archivo') ? 'uppercase' : 'none')}`
].join(";");

const fontGoogleUrl = (() => {
    const faces = [...new Set([fontHeading, fontBody])];
    const faceParams = faces.map(f => `family=${f.replace(/ /g, "+")}:wght@400;500;600;700;800`).join("&");
    return `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?${faceParams}&display=swap`;
})();

const rawMaterial = prepJson.material || $('Input Sanitizer1').first().json.material || "";

return sections.map((sec, idx) => ({
    json: {
        // Section narrative payload
        n:             sec.n || (idx + 1),
        kind:          sec.kind || (idx === 0 ? "hero" : (idx === sections.length - 1 ? "closing" : "parallax-split")),
        badge:         sec.badge || "",
        title:         sec.title || "",
        subtitle:      sec.subtitle || "",
        narrative:     sec.narrative || sec.focus || "",
        keyPoints:     sec.keyPoints || [],
        stats:         sec.stats || [],
        imageKeyword:  sec.customImageUrl ? "" : (sec.imageKeyword || "modern technology clean vibrant"),
        imageRequired: sec.customImageUrl ? false : (sec.imageRequired !== false),
        customImageUrl: sec.customImageUrl || undefined,
        imageUrl:      sec.customImageUrl || sec.imageUrl || undefined,
        chartType:     sec.chartType || "none",
        chartData:     sec.chartData || null,
        
        // Full User Material context
        material:      rawMaterial,
        
        // Design tokens
